headline: As of 2026-10-01: 757,567 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 27 of 50 states, D+38.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 757,567 early/mail ballots cast so far across 27 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+38.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (282,381), New Jersey (116,590), Michigan (64,427).
